decision: Hold all six at11671. Temporal-forecast mean25% versus original22% and lower-beta24% does not establish a substantial gain. No automatic second epoch or additional candidate grid.
interpretation: All methods improve with training budget. Two-seed50-case validation cannot establish superiority from1-3 percentage-point mean differences; do not claim equivalence either. Cube does not show the persistent encoder degeneration observed in TwoRoom, but learned denoising state/action dependence is insufficient evidence of effective planning.
